signs.text: Neighbour Lane: the gate opens soon.
A note on the bakery door: “Back soon, petal! The kitchen's in a state. Any help is lovely. — Hazel”
Riverside this way. The river path opens on day 3.

doors.closedText: The river path opens on day 3.
The beach path is all overgrown. Maybe in winter.

signs.text: The Far Bank. An old orchard, waiting for spring.

en-AU.hazel.meet.1: Oh! A dust bunny! I mean... hello, petal!
en-AU.hazel.busy.1: Busy, busy, petal! Pop back tomorrow?
en-AU.hazel.busy.2: Oh, the buns! Sorry petal, back to it.
en-AU.hazel.busy.3: Lovely to see you again, petal!
en-AU.hazel.morning.1: Up with the buns, petal! Six o'clock sharp.
en-AU.hazel.morning.2: Smell that? First batch of the day.
en-AU.hazel.day.1: Shop's open! Mind the queue, petal.
en-AU.hazel.day.2: Bread, buns, tarts... and a bit of chaos.
en-AU.hazel.evening.1: Nearly done for the day. Nearly.
en-AU.hazel.night.1: Still up, petal? The dough's resting. Me too.
en-AU.hazel.night.2: Shh... the bread's asleep. So should we be.
en-AU.hazel.spring.1: Spring! Everyone wants hot cross buns.
en-AU.hazel.spring.2: The blossom's out. Flour's out too. Everywhere.
en-AU.hazel.spring.3: Spring cleaning, petal? I'd love a hand.
en-AU.hazel.rainy.1: Rain on the roof, bread in the oven. Bliss.
en-AU.hazel.rainy.2: Wipe your paws, petal! Oh, you're fine.
en-AU.hazel.h0.1: {puff}, petal, could you just... oh, the buns!
en-AU.hazel.h0.2: You're the bunny who tidies? How kind.
en-AU.hazel.h0.3: Have a crumb, petal. Go on.
en-AU.hazel.h3.2: Sit with me a tick? Just a tick.
en-AU.hazel.h3.3: You make the kitchen feel lighter, petal.
en-AU.hazel.h6.1: I sat down today, petal. A whole minute!
en-AU.hazel.h6.3: Saved you the crispy corner piece.
en-AU.hazel.h9.1: My dearest petal! Tea's already poured.
en-AU.hazel.h9.2: Feet up, oven off. Who knew?
en-AU.hazel.restored.1: My kitchen! It sparkles! Oh, petal, thank you.
en-AU.bea.meet.1: Three things! One: hello! Two: a bunny! Three: hello!
en-AU.bea.busy.1: Two things! One: lovely. Two: busy! Bye!
en-AU.bea.busy.2: Back tomorrow? I'll write it on a list.
en-AU.bea.busy.3: One thing: you're nice. That's the list.
en-AU.bea.morning.1: Three things! Dew, daisies, and you. Morning!
en-AU.bea.morning.2: Watering list: done. Hello list: now!
en-AU.bea.day.1: Lists from one till two. Don't tell anyone.
en-AU.bea.day.2: Two things! One: seeds. Two: more seeds.
en-AU.bea.evening.1: River walk soon. It's on the list. Lovely.
en-AU.bea.evening.2: One thing: the sunset. That's it. Wow.
en-AU.bea.night.1: Still up? Me too. Re-reading my lists.
en-AU.bea.night.2: Three things: moon, stars, a sleepy bee.
en-AU.bea.spring.1: Spring! Seeds! Everything! All at once!
en-AU.bea.spring.2: Tulips first, then peas. It's on the list.
en-AU.bea.spring.3: Three things! Blossom, bees, and... me!
en-AU.bea.rainy.1: Rain! Free watering! Best kind of day.
en-AU.bea.rainy.2: Two things! One: wet. Two: worth it.
en-AU.bea.h0.1: Have we met? Yes! Twice. It's on my list.
en-AU.bea.h0.2: One thing: do you like flowers? Good.
en-AU.bea.h0.3: Three things! Hello, hello, and hello.
en-AU.bea.h3.1: You're on my favourite-people list now.
en-AU.bea.h3.2: Two things! One: thank you. Two: really.
en-AU.bea.h3.3: I made you a list. It just says '{puff}'.
en-AU.bea.h6.1: I let a daisy grow wherever it liked. Eek!
en-AU.bea.h6.2: One thing: lists aren't everything. Shh.
en-AU.bea.h6.3: Pick a flower. Any flower. No plan!
en-AU.bea.h9.1: No list today. Just you and me. Lovely.
en-AU.bea.h9.2: Three things! You, me, and a wild flower bed.
en-AU.bea.h9.3: Best friend. That's the whole list.
en-AU.bea.restored.1: Hazel's kitchen shines! My window's next. Kidding!
en-AU.pip.meet.1: Is that a real bunny? Can I draw you? Right?
en-AU.pip.busy.2: Oops, glue on my paw. Tomorrow, right?
en-AU.pip.morning.1: Mmf... it's not ten yet. Is it? Right?
en-AU.pip.day.1: I'm making a whirly-bob. Kind of. Right?
en-AU.pip.evening.1: The workshop's at its glowiest now. Right?
en-AU.pip.night.1: Night-time ideas are the best ideas, right?
en-AU.pip.night.2: Shh, the toys are sleeping. Not really.
en-AU.pip.spring.1: Spring! I'm making a bunny-copter. For you!
en-AU.pip.spring.2: Found a button in the blossom. Lucky, right?
en-AU.pip.spring.3: Spring smells like glue and flowers.
en-AU.pip.rainy.2: Drip-drop toy! I just made that up.
en-AU.pip.h0.1: You tidy things? Wow. I just... make things.
en-AU.pip.h0.2: Want a half-made toy? It's mostly a toy.
en-AU.pip.h3.1: You're my favourite visitor. Shh, don't tell.
en-AU.pip.h3.2: I made a tiny broom. It's for you. Kind of.
en-AU.pip.h3.3: Hazel says you're good luck. I say yes.
en-AU.pip.h6.1: We finished one! A whole toy! Right?!
en-AU.pip.h6.2: Some toys are for friends far away.
en-AU.pip.h6.3: You make the workshop feel less quiet.
en-AU.pip.h9.1: Everyone can come in now. Even messy days.
en-AU.pip.h9.2: There's a {puff} toy on my shelf. It's you!
en-AU.pip.restored.1: Hazel's kitchen is so shiny! More crumbs for me!
en-AU.hazel.gift.loved: Oh, petal! My favourite! How did you know?
en-AU.hazel.gift.neutral: For me? Aw, thank you, petal.
en-AU.hazel.gift.disliked: Not near the dough, petal! Kind thought, though.
en-AU.bea.gift.loved: Three things! One: WOW. Two: thank you. Three: WOW!
en-AU.bea.gift.liked: Two things! One: lovely. Two: thank you!
en-AU.bea.gift.neutral: A present! It's going on my thank-you list.
en-AU.bea.gift.disliked: One thing: not really my thing. But thank you!
en-AU.pip.gift.loved: For me?! This is the best-est thing! Right?!
en-AU.pip.gift.liked: Ooh! I can make something with this, right?
en-AU.pip.gift.neutral: A present! I'll find it a job. Thanks!
en-AU.pip.gift.disliked: Hmm, that's for later. Much later! Thanks though.
en-AU.he_hazel_02.l01: {puff}, petal! The morning rush has doubled lately.
en-AU.he_hazel_02.l02: And the oven... well. It's seen busier days.
en-AU.he_hazel_02.l03: You dusted my counter on your very first day.
en-AU.he_hazel_02.l04: You've been such a help around here, petal.
en-AU.he_hazel_02.l05: I love an oven. Ovens are cosy.
en-AU.he_hazel_02.l06: Ha! Then you're the bunny for the job.
en-AU.he_hazel_04.l01: Mm? Oh! Petal! I wasn't asleep. Standing up.
en-AU.he_hazel_04.l02: You could sit down, you know.
en-AU.he_hazel_04.l03: Sit? Me? Who'd mind the buns?
en-AU.he_hazel_04.l04: I bake for everyone, petal. I never sit down.
en-AU.he_hazel_04.l05: If I stop... would anyone still need me?
en-AU.he_hazel_04.l06: We'd still need you. Sitting or not.
en-AU.he_hazel_04.l07: ...Oh, petal. Maybe just one tick, then.
en-AU.he_hazel_06.l01: Petal, I've decided. Sundays, I'm closed!
en-AU.he_hazel_06.l02: Help me paint the sign? You pick the colour.
en-AU.he_hazel_06.c03: Which colour for the Closed Sundays sign?
en-AU.he_hazel_06.l04: Perfect. And here, a little recipe for you.
en-AU.he_hazel_06.l05: Snacks for busy days. Cook them when you like.
en-AU.he_hazel_08.l01: {puff}, petal! Gran's tart. Help me get it right?
en-AU.he_hazel_08.l03: You dusted my counter on your very first day.
en-AU.he_hazel_08.l04: You've helped so much this spring, petal.
en-AU.he_hazel_08.l05: I've never got it quite right. One step's missing.
en-AU.he_hazel_08.l06: Maybe it isn't in the bowl. Maybe it's after?
en-AU.he_hazel_08.c07: The missing step: share it while it's warm. Who first?
en-AU.he_hazel_08.l08: Warm and shared. Gran would be proud.
en-AU.he_hazel_10.l01: {puff}! Shop's tidy, feet are up, tea's poured.
en-AU.he_hazel_10.l02: Three things! Tea, tart, and Hazel SITTING.
en-AU.he_hazel_10.l03: I got the first tart! I'm keeping the crumbs!
en-AU.he_hazel_10.l04: Just us two, petal. Gran's tart and good company.
en-AU.he_hazel_10.l05: This is the cosiest kitchen in {town}.
en-AU.he_hazel_10.l06: Because of you, petal. Thank you. Truly.
en-AU.he_bea_02.l01: Three things! One: the front shop is perfect.
en-AU.he_bea_02.l02: Two: please don't open that back door.
en-AU.he_bea_02.l04: Three: chaos. Total chaos. Lists everywhere.
en-AU.he_bea_02.l05: I could help? I like chaos. Gently.
en-AU.he_bea_02.l06: You'd do that? I'll... add it to a list!
en-AU.he_bea_04.l01: I've got a list of lists, {puff}.
en-AU.he_bea_04.l02: If I forget one thing, someone's let down.
en-AU.he_bea_04.l03: What if we threw one list away? Just one.
en-AU.he_bea_04.l05: Gone! Three things: light. Light. Light!
en-AU.he_bea_06.l01: Two things! One: I have a greenhouse.
en-AU.he_bea_06.l02: Two: it's yours to use. Grow anything!
en-AU.he_bea_06.l04: Especially wobbly ones. That's new for me.
en-AU.he_bea_08.l01: {puff}, you choose the window this week.
en-AU.he_bea_08.l02: No list! Just... whatever feels nice.
en-AU.he_bea_08.l04: Oh! It's not perfect. It's lovely.
en-AU.he_bea_10.l01: One thing. Come and look. No list.
en-AU.he_bea_10.l02: A flower bed for you. I didn't plan a thing!
en-AU.he_bea_10.l03: Every seed you ever gave me is in there.
en-AU.he_bea_10.l04: It's wild. It's perfect. Wait, not perfect...
en-AU.he_bea_10.l05: Wild is better. You taught me that.
en-AU.he_pip_02.l01: Mind the toys! They're everywhere. Right?
en-AU.he_pip_02.l02: A bunny-copter, a sock-snake, a wobble-dog...
en-AU.he_pip_02.l04: Finishing is the scary bit. Starting's fun!
en-AU.he_pip_02.l05: Want help finishing one? Just one?
en-AU.he_pip_04.l01: Can I tell you something? Promise, right?
en-AU.he_pip_04.l02: Every toy is for Wren. My best friend.
en-AU.he_pip_04.l03: Wren moved away. Far, far away.
en-AU.he_pip_04.l05: If I finish one... it's goodbye, right?
en-AU.he_pip_04.l06: Or hello. Toys can say hello too.
en-AU.he_pip_06.l01: We're finishing one! Today! Right now!
en-AU.he_pip_06.l02: It needs a button for a nose. Pick one?
en-AU.he_pip_06.l04: Done! A whole toy! It's a real toy!
en-AU.he_pip_06.l05: And I stitched you a bigger bag. Thank you!
en-AU.he_pip_08.l01: I'm mailing the toy to Wren. Right?
en-AU.he_pip_08.l02: And... there's a letter. I never opened it.
en-AU.he_pip_08.l04: 'Dear Pip, I miss you. Write soon. Wren.'
en-AU.he_pip_08.l05: It wasn't goodbye. It was never goodbye.
en-AU.he_pip_10.l01: Wren wrote back! With a drawing of the toy!
en-AU.he_pip_10.l02: So I'm opening the workshop. To everyone!
en-AU.he_pip_10.l03: And look on the shelf. Recognise someone?
en-AU.req.hazel_tables: Sweep the crumbs by Hazel's café tables.
en-AU.req.hazel_radish: Bring Hazel a fresh radish for her soup.
en-AU.req.bea_weeds: Rake the weeds by the notice board for Bea.
en-AU.req.bea_seeds: Bea would love a packet of radish seeds.
en-AU.req.pip_cup: Pip needs a cup for paint water.
en-AU.req.pip_tart: Bring Pip a berry tart. Crumbs welcome!
en-AU.hazel.request.done: You're a treasure, petal. Thank you!
en-AU.bea.request.done: Three things! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
en-AU.pip.request.done: You did it! Best helper ever, right?
en-AU.otto.meet.1: Well, hello! Water you doing here? Heh. I'm Otto!
en-AU.otto.busy.1: Brass won't polish itself! Back tomorrow? Heh.
en-AU.otto.busy.2: Otter things to do! Heh. See you tomorrow!
en-AU.otto.busy.3: Still here, still bubbly! Heh heh.
en-AU.otto.morning.1: Up with the fish! Not that they wanted me up.
en-AU.otto.morning.2: Morning! The river's all sparkly at this hour.
en-AU.otto.day.1: Polishing Uncle Brook's brass. It likes a shine.
en-AU.otto.day.2: Every tap in here squeaks. I've named them all.
en-AU.otto.evening.1: Evening's for the jetty. Just sitting. Thinking.
en-AU.otto.evening.2: Listen. The river sounds different at dusk.
en-AU.otto.night.1: Shh. The bubbles are asleep. Heh. Kidding.
en-AU.otto.night.2: Stars on the water. Two skies for the price of one.
en-AU.otto.spring.1: Spring melt! The river's in a hurry today.
en-AU.otto.spring.2: A blossom floated by this morning. Lucky river.
en-AU.otto.spring.3: Spring means bubble season. Every season does.
en-AU.otto.rainy.1: Rain! The river's having a bath too. Heh.
en-AU.otto.rainy.2: Puddles are tiny bathhouses. I approve.
en-AU.otto.h0.1: A dust bunny at a bathhouse! That's a first. Heh.
en-AU.otto.h0.2: Mind the soap scum. There's... a lot. Heh. Sorry.
en-AU.otto.h0.3: You're welcome here any time. Bring bubbles!
en-AU.otto.h3.1: You make the place feel open again. Nearly.
en-AU.otto.h3.2: Uncle Brook would have liked you. A lot.
en-AU.otto.h3.3: I saved you the best towel. The fluffy one!
en-AU.otto.h6.1: Doors open! Real guests! Can you believe it?
en-AU.otto.h6.2: The brass shines like Brook kept it. Better, maybe.
en-AU.otto.h6.3: Some days I laugh because it's easier. Not today.
en-AU.otto.h9.1: Bath night was the best night. Thanks, friend.
en-AU.otto.h9.2: Still not a swimmer. But I'm a top paddler!
en-AU.otto.h9.3: This place is mine now. Brook's and mine.
en-AU.otto.restored.1: Look at it gleam! I think Brook's smiling.
en-AU.otto.gift.loved: For me?! I could do a backflip. Heh. Thanks!
en-AU.otto.gift.liked: Ooh, nice one! That's going on the windowsill.
en-AU.otto.gift.neutral: A present? You're a good egg. Er, bunny.
en-AU.otto.gift.disliked: Ah, not really my thing. Kind of you, though!
en-AU.otto.request.done: You're a star! A wet, sparkly star. Thanks!
en-AU.otto.meet.1.alt: Well, hello! What brings you down here? I'm Otto!
en-AU.otto.busy.2.alt: So much to do! Heh. See you tomorrow!
en-AU.moss.meet.1: Oh. ... Hello. ... You may stay. Quietly.
en-AU.moss.busy.1: ... That's enough talking for today. Thank you.
en-AU.moss.busy.2: ... I'm in the middle of a chapter.
en-AU.moss.morning.1: ... It's early. The books are still asleep.
en-AU.moss.day.1: Shelving. ... A to M today. N to Z tomorrow.
en-AU.moss.day.2: ... The curtains stay shut. Light fades pages.
en-AU.moss.evening.1: Evening is quiet. ... I like quiet.
en-AU.moss.evening.2: ... Pip came by. Only for a minute. It was nice.
en-AU.moss.night.1: ... You heard me reading? Oh. ... It's nothing.
en-AU.moss.night.2: Night is the best time for stories. ... Shh.
en-AU.moss.spring.2: ... Someone waters my doorstep plants. Not me.
en-AU.moss.spring.3: Spring cleaning. ... You'd know about that.
en-AU.moss.rainy.1: Rain on the roof. ... The best reading sound.
en-AU.moss.rainy.2: ... Rainy days. Nobody visits. I don't mind.
en-AU.moss.h0.1: ... You're tidying? Mind the stacks. Please.
en-AU.moss.h0.2: Shh. ... Sorry. Habit. You may speak.
en-AU.moss.h0.3: ... The dust has been here longer than me.
en-AU.moss.h3.1: ... I saved you a chair. The good one.
en-AU.moss.h3.2: You don't fill the quiet. ... I like that.
en-AU.moss.h3.3: ... Mabel lends me maps. I'll show you one.
en-AU.moss.h6.1: The cellar nook is ready. ... One seat. Yours too.
en-AU.moss.h6.2: ... I wave now. When I want company. See?
en-AU.moss.h6.3: ... Some days are people days. Today is one.
en-AU.moss.h9.1: Quiet hour went well. ... Four whole visitors.
en-AU.moss.h9.2: ... I'm glad you came in. That first day.
en-AU.moss.h9.3: You're in my story. ... You don't mind?
en-AU.moss.restored.1: ... The light came in. The books seem happier.
en-AU.moss.gift.loved: ... Oh. ... For me? ... Thank you. Truly.
en-AU.moss.gift.neutral: ... A gift. Thank you. ... I'll find it a shelf.
en-AU.moss.gift.disliked: Atchoo. ... Sorry. ... Kind, though. Thank you.
en-AU.moss.request.done: ... Thank you. That was ... very kind.
en-AU.mabel.meet.1: Hoo. So you're the one who tidies. Welcome, dear.
en-AU.mabel.busy.1: Hoo. A long night for an old owl. Tomorrow, dear.
en-AU.mabel.busy.2: Rest your paws, dear. Talk keeps till dusk.
en-AU.mabel.busy.3: Hoo. Still here? Many paws, light work.
en-AU.mabel.morning.1: Hoo... awake at this hour? Owls and dew don't mix.
en-AU.mabel.morning.2: Morning, dear. My feathers say it's bedtime.
en-AU.mabel.day.1: Hoo. Daylight's for sleeping. But for you, a minute.
en-AU.mabel.day.2: The sun's so bright, dear. I'll squint and smile.
en-AU.mabel.evening.1: Evening, dear. The square is kind at this hour.
en-AU.mabel.evening.2: Hoo. Lamps on, hearts warm. That's the way.
en-AU.mabel.night.1: Night's my time. Sit a while, if you like.
en-AU.mabel.night.2: Hoo. See the candle by the sea? That's mine.
en-AU.mabel.spring.1: Spring's a promise, dear. Keep it, it keeps you.
en-AU.mabel.spring.2: Hoo. Blossom slow, blossom sweet. Spring's complete.
en-AU.mabel.spring.3: I smell spring on you. And a little soap.
en-AU.mabel.rainy.1: Rain on the sea, rain on the square. Hoo.
en-AU.mabel.rainy.2: A wet night's a story night, dear.
en-AU.mabel.h0.1: Hoo. The fountain's quiet. It wasn't always.
en-AU.mabel.h0.2: Busy paws, kind heart. Mind you rest, dear.
en-AU.mabel.h0.3: I knew this town when it sparkled, dear.
en-AU.mabel.h3.1: Hoo. You remind me of someone. Can't think who.
en-AU.mabel.h3.2: Otto's doing better. You've helped there.
en-AU.mabel.h3.3: Old maps, old friends. Both worth keeping.
en-AU.mabel.h6.1: Lamp nights are back. Hoo. Who'd have thought?
en-AU.mabel.h6.2: The climb is easier with a rail. And a friend.
en-AU.mabel.h6.3: Brook would laugh to see the bathhouse now.
en-AU.mabel.h9.1: Hoo. Many paws, light work. You showed us that.
en-AU.mabel.h9.2: You're the little keeper, dear. I always hoped.
en-AU.mabel.h9.3: Whatever comes, the light remembers you.
en-AU.mabel.restored.1: Hoo. Brook's bathhouse, bright again. Thank you.
en-AU.mabel.gift.loved: Hoo! For me? You've a good eye, dear. Thank you.
en-AU.mabel.gift.liked: How thoughtful. A kind gift for an old owl.
en-AU.mabel.gift.neutral: Hoo. A present. That's sweet of you, dear.
en-AU.mabel.gift.disliked: Hoo. Not for me, dear. But the thought's lovely.
en-AU.mabel.request.done: Hoo. Kindly done, dear. Kindly done.
en-AU.he_otto_02.l01: Welcome to the bathhouse! Well. It's closed.
en-AU.he_otto_02.l02: Soap scum on every tile. Heh. Bit much, eh?
en-AU.he_otto_02.l03: I could scrub? Scrubbing is my favourite.
en-AU.he_otto_02.l04: You'd do that? For a bathhouse nobody visits?
en-AU.he_otto_02.l06: Heh. Heh! Then it's open. For one.
en-AU.he_otto_04.l01: This was Uncle Brook's. Forty years, he ran it.
en-AU.he_otto_04.l03: I'm not sure I'm... Brook enough. You know?
en-AU.he_otto_04.l04: You don't have to be Brook. You're Otto.
en-AU.he_otto_04.l05: ...Heh. I'm Otto. Yeah. I can be Otto.
en-AU.he_otto_06.l01: Big news! The bathhouse reopens. Today!
en-AU.he_otto_06.l02: The first guest gets the good towel. Who's first?
en-AU.he_otto_06.c03: Who gets the first good towel?
en-AU.he_otto_06.l04: Perfect! And for you, Brook's squeegee plans.
en-AU.he_otto_06.l05: A Silver squeegee. Windows won't know what hit them!
en-AU.he_otto_08.l01: I'm adding a bubble bath. For tired neighbours.
en-AU.he_otto_08.l02: Can I tell you a secret? I can't really swim.
en-AU.he_otto_08.l03: That's okay. Want to paddle in the shallows?
en-AU.he_otto_08.l05: Together. Paws in, nice and slow.
en-AU.he_otto_08.l06: Ha! Look at us. Two paddlers. Heh.
en-AU.he_otto_10.l01: Bath night! The whole town came. Can you hear?
en-AU.he_otto_10.l02: Hoo. Brook once fell in his own pool, you know.
en-AU.he_otto_10.l03: In his best waistcoat. He came up laughing.
en-AU.he_otto_10.l04: He did?! Ha! Ha ha! Oh, that's so Brook.
en-AU.he_otto_10.l05: First real laugh in ages. Thanks, {puff}.
en-AU.he_moss_02.l01: ... Books. Floor to ceiling. I know.
en-AU.he_moss_02.l02: The curtains stay shut. ... Fewer visitors.
en-AU.he_moss_02.l03: Could I shelve a few? Very quietly?
en-AU.he_moss_04.l01: ... Can I say something? ... People tire me out.
en-AU.he_moss_04.l02: Not you. ... Everyone. All at once.
en-AU.he_moss_04.l03: Then I'll only come in when you wave.
en-AU.he_moss_04.l04: ... A waving sign. For the window. ... Yes.
en-AU.he_moss_04.c05: What goes on the waving sign?
en-AU.he_moss_06.l01: ... There's a cellar. I've never shown anyone.
en-AU.he_moss_06.l02: A reading nook. ... Just for one.
en-AU.he_moss_06.l03: It's so cosy. It's like a burrow!
en-AU.he_moss_06.l04: ... Use it whenever you like. ... You count.
en-AU.he_moss_08.l01: ... I'm starting a quiet hour. For others.
en-AU.he_moss_08.l02: Reading. No talking. ... Pip wants to come.
en-AU.he_moss_08.l03: ... And. ... I write stories. Here's one.
en-AU.he_moss_08.l04: "The Dust Bunny Who Stayed." ...Is that me?
en-AU.he_moss_08.l05: ... Maybe. ... Don't read it out loud. Yet.
en-AU.he_moss_10.l01: ... I'm going to read my story. Out loud.
en-AU.he_moss_10.l03: "On its very first day, it dusted Hazel's counter."
en-AU.he_moss_10.l04: "It made the bakery shine like a new loaf."
en-AU.he_moss_10.l05: "It tidied Bea's back room, lists and all."
en-AU.he_moss_10.l06: "It found a home for every one of Pip's toys."
en-AU.he_moss_10.l07: "It scrubbed the bathhouse till it sang."
en-AU.he_moss_10.l08: "Wherever it tidied, the colour came back."
en-AU.he_moss_10.l09: "And the town remembered how to gather." ... The end.
en-AU.he_moss_10.l10: Moss. That's the best story I've ever heard.
en-AU.he_moss_10.l11: ... It's a true one. ... That's the trick.
en-AU.he_mabel_02.l01: Hoo. Out by the sea there's a lighthouse. Mine.
en-AU.he_mabel_02.l02: Salt on every window. The light's been off for years.
en-AU.he_mabel_02.l03: Off? Then how do the boats find their way?
en-AU.he_mabel_02.l04: A candle in my window, dear. It's what I can do.
en-AU.he_mabel_02.l05: Light a small light, and the big ones remember.
en-AU.he_mabel_04.l01: The lighthouse stairs are long, dear. So long.
en-AU.he_mabel_04.l02: The rail's loose and the steps are dim. So I stopped.
en-AU.he_mabel_04.l03: Then let's fix the rail. I'm good at fixing.
en-AU.he_mabel_04.l04: Hoo. Pip lent you his little hammer, I see.
en-AU.he_mabel_04.l05: Tap, tap. Steady as a branch. Thank you, dear.
en-AU.he_mabel_06.l01: Hoo. An idea, dear. A lamp night, here in the square.
en-AU.he_mabel_06.l02: Everyone brings a little light. Like we used to.
en-AU.he_mabel_06.l04: Lovely. Light that's shared is light that's doubled.
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l01: Hoo. Sit, dear. I've brought my oldest maps.
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l02: See? The Glimmerwell. The town gathered here.
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l03: Every spring. "Many paws, light work," we said.
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l04: And here, by the rim. A little drawing.
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l05: "The Well's little keeper, born of what we let fall."
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l06: It looks a bit like... a dust bunny?
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l07: Hoo. You've even woken Brook's bathhouse. I knew it.
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l08: Hoo. One home at a time, dear. I knew it.
en-AU.he_mabel_08.l09: I've waited a long time to meet you, dear.
en-AU.he_mabel_10.l01: Hoo. Tonight's the night, dear. Winter Lights.
en-AU.he_mabel_10.l02: Up we go, Mabel. One step. Then another.
en-AU.he_mabel_10.l03: Many paws, light work. Light the lamp, dear.
en-AU.he_mabel_10.l04: It's lit! Look, the fountain's lighting up too!
en-AU.he_mabel_10.l05: Hoo. The town remembered how to gather.
en-AU.he_mabel_10.l06: Thank you, little keeper. Welcome home.
en-AU.req.otto_shell: Otto's windowsill needs a shell. Just one!
en-AU.req.otto_fog: Clear the foggy patches by Otto's pool.
en-AU.req.moss_book: Moss would like a book. Any book. Quietly.
en-AU.req.moss_cobwebs: Dust the cobwebs in Moss's reading corner.
en-AU.req.mabel_mud: Clear the mud by Mabel's evening bench.
en-AU.req.mabel_biscuit: Mabel fancies a biscuit with her evening tea.
en-AU.alive.burrow.home: It's... a home. Is it mine?|It's mine.
en-AU.alive.bakery.tarts: Fresh tarts on the display. Yum!
en-AU.alive.bakery.home: It smells like a real bakery again.
en-AU.alive.store.lamp: A lamp on the counter. Hello, shop!
en-AU.alive.store.sun: Look at the light on the shelves.
en-AU.alive.store.home: Flowers and a robin. Open for business!
en-AU.alive.pip_workshop.boat: A little boat! Did Pip make that?
en-AU.alive.pip_workshop.home: Toys everywhere, in the best way.
en-AU.alive.library.sun: Sunlight on the spines. So quiet.
en-AU.alive.library.home: A good book and a warm lamp. Perfect.
en-AU.alive.yard.robin: A robin on the mailbox. Hello!
en-AU.alive.square.birds: Birds at the fountain. A good sign.
en-AU.alive.riverside.lamps: Lamps by the water. So twinkly!
en-AU.alive.riverside.home: The river sparkles back at me.
en-AU.keeper.day1.hazel.1: Oh! The colour's back. No mayor here, petal...
en-AU.keeper.day1.hazel.2: ...but the Glimmerwell needs a Keeper. Will you be ours?
en-AU.keeper.day1.puff.1: Me? I only just woke up... but yes. I'd love to.
en-AU.keeper.day1.hazel.3: Here's the badge. Keeper of {town}! Now, a tart...
en-AU.build.wanted: A notice: 'Keeper wanted. Kind paws only.'
en-AU.build.place: Here, I think. It'll be cosy here.
en-AU.build.done: The new {building} is finished. Come see!
en-AU.build.hint: Check the Keeper's plans in the square.
en-AU.grumble.puff.first: Oh! A little grey puff. You look like me!
en-AU.grumble.puff.tidy: Hello, grumbly. Let's brighten you up.
en-AU.grumble.hint: Something grey is grumbling on Neighbour Lane.
en-AU.pet.cat.line: A sleepy cat who loves sunbeams.
en-AU.pet.pup.line: A waggy pup who loves walks.
en-AU.pet.hedgehoglet.line: A shy hedgehoglet who loves crunchy leaves.
en-AU.pet.arrive: Someone's at the door! Three little visitors.
en-AU.pet.hint: Someone's waiting at your burrow door.
en-AU.craft.none: Pip's workbench. Learn a recipe at the General Store!
en-AU.craft.made: {tool}! Hold on mess to clean a little patch at once.
en-AU.crop.strawberry.harvest: A strawberry! More will grow back.
en-AU.cook.none: Nothing to cook yet. Grow something first!
en-AU.find.any: Ooh, a little treasure! Moss will love this.
en-AU.find.thimble: A thimble... like the old Keeper's name.
en-AU.find.tiny_key: A tiny key. What could it open?
en-AU.decor.where: Where shall it go? Tap the ground.
en-AU.decor.outside: Decor goes outside: the yard, square, Lane or Riverside.
en-AU.decor.cuts_off: That would block the way. Somewhere else?
en-AU.decor.tracker: Tap the ground to place it. Tap Puff to stop.
en-AU.letter.mabel_1.l1: To whoever is bringing the colour back:
en-AU.letter.mabel_1.l2: I saw it from far off, over the water. Hoo!
en-AU.letter.mabel_1.l3: Here's an old map leaf. It shows the way down. M.
en-AU.letter.mabel_1.r1: Thank you, M.! I'll keep tidying.
en-AU.letter.mabel_2.l1: The Glimmerwell hums when it's happy.
en-AU.letter.mabel_2.l2: Listen to it at dawn, little Keeper. M.
en-AU.letter.mabel_3.l1: Long ago, the town met at the fountain each spring.
en-AU.letter.mabel_3.l2: They called it Many Paws. I loved the dancing. M.
en-AU.letter.mabel_4.l1: A friend is a lamp that stays lit, even far away.
en-AU.letter.mabel_4.l2: Thank you for writing back. It means a lot. M.
en-AU.letter.mabel_5.l1: The water under the town remembers everything.
en-AU.letter.mabel_5.l2: When the cold comes, look for me by the sea. M.
en-AU.letter.hint: A bottle's washed up by the fountain.
en-AU.letter.sent: Off it floats. I hope M. reads it soon.
en-AU.cave.closed: The fountain's so quiet... Something's down there.
en-AU.cave.enter: Ooh. It's cool down here. And sparkly.
en-AU.cave.shard: A bit of {town}'s colour! Let's bring it home.
en-AU.cave.ore: Copper ore! Pip will love this.
en-AU.cave.tired: Mining takes Fluff. A snack first?
en-AU.letter.title: A letter in a bottle
en-AU.letter.sorrel_1.title: A letter for the Keeper
en-AU.letter.sorrel_1.hint: There's a letter by the Lane sign.
en-AU.letter.sorrel_1.sent: Off it goes! Let's find Sorrel a home.
en-AU.letter.sorrel_1.l1: Dear Keeper of {town}, I'm Sorrel, from over the hills.
en-AU.letter.sorrel_1.l2: I heard the colour's coming back. Is there room for me?
en-AU.letter.sorrel_1.l3: I'd love a little cottage. I'm very good at tidy! Sorrel
en-AU.invite.hint: Sorrel needs a home. See the Keeper's plans.
en-AU.sorrel.meet.1: Hi! You're the Keeper! I'm Sorrel. I live here now!
en-AU.sorrel.busy.1: Unpacking! So many boxes. Pop by tomorrow?
en-AU.sorrel.busy.2: Oops, left the kettle on! See you tomorrow!
en-AU.sorrel.morning.1: Morning! I've been up since the first bird.
en-AU.sorrel.morning.2: I counted the Lane's flowers. Forty-two!
en-AU.sorrel.day.1: Everyone here waves. I love that.
en-AU.sorrel.day.2: I'm learning every path. Left, left, then the fountain!
en-AU.sorrel.evening.1: The lamps come on one by one. Like a song.
en-AU.sorrel.evening.2: My cottage smells of new wood. And jam.
en-AU.sorrel.night.1: Shh, I'm nearly asleep. Night, Keeper!
en-AU.sorrel.night.2: Stars over the Lane! Better than the hills.
en-AU.sorrel.spring.1: Spring in a new town! Everything's a first.
en-AU.sorrel.spring.2: I planted a seed by my door. Hope it likes me.
en-AU.sorrel.spring.3: Blossom on my windowsill! It found me.
en-AU.sorrel.rainy.1: Rain on a new roof sounds so cosy.
en-AU.sorrel.rainy.2: My tail's a little umbrella. Mostly.
en-AU.sorrel.h0.1: Thank you for my home. I still can't believe it.
en-AU.sorrel.h0.2: Who's the baker? Hazel? I must say hello!
en-AU.sorrel.h0.3: I'm a bit shy. But you make it easy.
en-AU.sorrel.h3.1: I wrote to my sister. I said I'm happy here.
en-AU.sorrel.h3.2: Bea gave me honey! Everyone's so kind.
en-AU.sorrel.h3.3: Want to see my acorn jar? It's very full.
en-AU.sorrel.h6.1: This feels like home now. Really home.
en-AU.sorrel.h6.2: I helped Pip with a gear today! A tiny one.
en-AU.sorrel.h6.3: Some nights I miss the hills. Then I see the lamps.
en-AU.sorrel.h9.1: Best friends? I hope so. I think so!
en-AU.sorrel.h9.2: I'll tell newcomers about you. The kind Keeper.
en-AU.sorrel.h9.3: You built me a home. I'll help you build a town.
en-AU.sorrel.gift.loved: For me?! Oh, I'll save this forever. Thank you!
en-AU.sorrel.gift.liked: Ooh, lovely! It's going on my new shelf.
en-AU.sorrel.gift.neutral: A present for me? You're so sweet. Thanks!
en-AU.sorrel.gift.disliked: Oh! Not really for me. But thank you, truly.
en-AU.sorrel.request.done: You did it! Thank you, Keeper!
en-AU.req.sorrel_flowers: Sorrel would love flowers for her new window.
en-AU.req.sorrel_weeds: Pull the weeds by Sorrel's front door.
en-AU.home.sorrel: Sorrel's moved in! Say hello on the Lane.
en-AU.repair.wait: The footbridge is too wobbly to cross. One day!
en-AU.repair.hint: The footbridge could be mended. See the Keeper's plans.
en-AU.alive.far_bank.lamp: A lamp on the Far Bank! Hello over there!
en-AU.alive.far_bank.flowers: Flowers by the old pond. It remembers spring.
en-AU.alive.far_bank.home: Birds in the orchard trees. It sings again!
en-AU.repair.start: Everyone's pitching in. Two nights, and it's mended!
en-AU.grumble.cobweb.hint: Something wispy is grumbling in Moss's library.
en-AU.grumble.mud.hint: Something squelchy is grumbling by the river.
en-AU.grumble.soot.hint: Something smudgy is grumbling at Otto's bathhouse.
